title: The exact GFF variance of balanced six-vertex heights
exact_target: For square-lattice six-vertex weights $a=b=1$ and fixed $0<c\leq 2$, does the prescribed iterated balanced-torus infinite-volume law exist, and do its rescaled heights modulo constants converge to a planar GFF with variance multiplier 1/arcsin(c/2)? Require joint finite-energy zero-mass measure tests, convergence in the stated negative Besov and Sobolev restriction spaces, and all separated height-increment moments.
